about: Colours written by hand that hand-colours.mjs lets through, each with why. file = path from the repository root; kinds = which kinds (all when left out); match = a piece of the found text, to let one line through and not the whole file. A rule that lets nothing through fails --strict.

rules.why: The chat's charts tell many series apart: a categorical palette is data, not decoration (DESIGN.md Colors, 'Not used on the console').
The Resource Graph's relation lines and kinds: a categorical palette that is data (DESIGN.md Colors).
The Resource Graph's traffic lines (allowed, dropped, mixed): the graph library takes a colour value (DESIGN.md Colors, Literals).
The xterm terminal theme takes colour values, not classes; terminals stay dark in every mode (DESIGN.md Literals, Colour modes).
The xterm terminal theme takes colour values (DESIGN.md Literals).
Monaco's theme takes colour values; a see-through editor ground lets the rounded field show (DESIGN.md Literals).
The particle logo is drawn on a canvas, which takes colour values (DESIGN.md Literals: the three.js particles).
The sign-in page is a brand surface pinned to the brand ground (bg-[#020617], data-color-mode=default) with its glow (DESIGN.md Brand ground).
First setup is a brand surface pinned to the brand ground (DESIGN.md Brand ground).
Waiting for approval is a brand surface pinned to the brand ground (DESIGN.md Brand ground).
The sign-in scene and its particle logo are the brand surface DESIGN.md keeps unchanged (Overview, Interaction).
The sidebar menu's fade is a mask-image: only its alpha is used, no colour is drawn.
